method: Saved candidate and observation CSV replay against matched original source frames. Original observed tracker IDs are held fixed; recovery anchors are rebuilt in sampled frame order. No detector training or model inference was performed. This isolates optional recovery fingerprint acceptance and is not fresh end to end pipeline validation.

proposed_gate.meaning: At least ten percent of saturated appearance pixels must fall outside the largest four adjacent circular hue bins. Achromatic white or grey pixels remain excluded. This qualifies an optional recovery cue, not vehicle presence.

native_false_candidates.handling: Keep native observed boxes visible as unassigned candidates and exclude visually reviewed background IDs from participant measurements.

limitations: Footage-specific diagnostic from two battles at the same event; no independent event accuracy evidence.
Source interpretation and participant roles were reviewed by an AI assistant without expert validation.
Real monochrome cars may lose optional recovery, while native vehicle observations remain available.
Multicolor backgrounds may still satisfy this gate. Manual participant and geometry review remain necessary.
Gate preservation was checked against saved tracker identities; fresh tracker replay and final camera-cut behavior must be verified separately.
Raw source, inspection images and video derivatives remain private; numerical evidence can be packaged separately.
